title: Google NotebookLM: Turn Notes, PDFs & Books into an Interactive Brain
description: Google NotebookLM changes how research is organized. Upload dense books, academic papers, and lecture slides to create a personalized AI assistant that answers questions grounded strictly in your source documents.

promptSet.title: Grounded Source Synthesis & Comparative Analysis
promptSet.prompt: Based exclusively on the uploaded 4 research documents, compare the competing theories on economic inflation. Cite exact page numbers and quotes for each argument, without introducing outside knowledge.
instructions: Visit notebooklm.google.com and upload your study materials.
Ask specific questions to get fully cited answers with inline click-to-source links.
Generate an Audio Overview to listen to a 2-host podcast deep dive.
promptSet.exampleOutput: Comprehensive comparative synthesis with exact page citations from your source files.
